WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage,
       AVG(s.mean_usage - o.mean_usage) AS average_above_overall
FROM station_averages s
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE s.mean_usage > o.mean_usage;
